# All macro signatures

Every component macro and its option names in one file, for when a page needs several
components at once and you would rather not open six files.

`*` marks a required option. `label`, `hint`, `errorMessage` and `fieldset` are
documented in [_shared-params.md](_shared-params.md).

For option descriptions, and for *when* to use a component and how it should behave,
open its own reference file — this page is a signature index only.

**[govukAccordion](accordion.md)** — `govuk/components/accordion/macro.njk`

```
id*, headingLevel, classes, attributes, rememberExpanded, hideAllSectionsText, hideSectionText, hideSectionAriaLabelText, showAllSectionsText, showSectionText, showSectionAriaLabelText, items*: { heading*: { text*, html* }, summary: { text, html }, content*: { text*, html* }, expanded }
```

